name: Bounty: The Ash-Blade Chieftain
description: Hunt down and neutralize Kaelen the Ash-Blade, the dangerous outlaw leader ambushing supply trains across the rocky Ashlands.

stages.0: Inquire about the bandit threat with Commander Robert.
stages.1: Track down Kaelen the Ash-Blade in the rocky passes of the Ashlands.
stages.2: Defeat Kaelen and recover proof of his neutralization.
stages.3: Claim your 300¤ bounty reward from Commander Robert.

scenes.bodyText:
Robert leans forward over his desk, lowering his voice.

'Kaelen is an arrogant cutthroat, but he is quick with a blade. If you track him to the Ashlands and put an end to his raids, the garrison treasury will pay 300¤ bounty on the spot.'

choices.label: Report Kaelen defeated (Claim 300¤ Bounty)
choices.tooltip: Confirm that Kaelen has been neutralized and collect your reward.

choices.label: I will track Kaelen down in the Ashlands.
choices.tooltip: Accept the contract to hunt Kaelen.

scenes.bodyText: 'Splendid work, soldier. With Kaelen neutralized, the trade routes through the rocky passes are safe again. Here is your 300¤ bounty. You have done the garrison a tremendous service.'

choices.label: Thank you, Commander.
choices.tooltip: Pocket your reward and return to duty.
